description: Ministry of Justice - Order made to declare that the provisions of the Transfer of Offenders Act No. 5 of 1995 shall apply in respect of Ukraine
reasoning: This gazette content contains an order made under the Transfer of Offenders Act, No. 5 of 1995, which is a legal instrument. It involves the declaration that the provisions of this Act apply to Ukraine. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the application of existing legislation to a specific country, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
